The loop in i40e_get_capabilities can never end. The problem is that
although i40e_aq_discover_capabilities returns with an error if there's
a firmware problem
column2: the returned error is not checked. There is a check for

column1: pf->hw.aq.asq_last_status but that value is set to I40E_AQ_RC_OK on most
firmware problems.
When i40e_aq_discover_capabilities encounters a firmware problem
encounter the same problem on its next invocation. As the result
becomes endless. We hit this with I40E_ERR_ADMIN_QUEUE_TIMEOUT but looking
at the code
column2: it can happen with a range of other firmware errors.

column1: I don't know what the correct behavior should be: whether the firmware
should be retried a few times
be always set to the encountered firmware error (but then it would be
pointless and can be just replaced by the i40e_aq_discover_capabilities
return value). However
column2: the current behavior with an endless loop under the

column1: rtnl mutex(!) is unacceptable and Intel has not submitted a fix
explained the bug to them 7 months ago.
This may not be the best possible fix but it's better than hanging the whole
system on a firmware bug.
